>> Live from NPR News in Washington, I'm Corva Coleman.
New York Governor Kathy Hochul says she has signed an executive order naming New York
Attorney General Letitia James as a special prosecutor.
James is going to investigate a reported case of a gang rape at Cornell University in 2024.
Hochul says the university police did not turn over all the information about the case,
and the local district attorney did not completely examine the facts of the case
of what the woman reported.
>> She spoke to the police.

Yet, shockingly, those words never made it into the account
that the Cornell police sent to prosecutors.
>> Attorney General Letitia James says it will take time to examine the facts.

>> U.S. employers added just 29,000 jobs last month,
far fewer than forecasters had predicted.
Factories and construction companies added workers in September,
but government and financial services cut jobs.
Employment gains for July and August were also revised lower,
and the unemployment rate inched up to 4.2%.
Investors think the lackluster jobs report makes it less likely the Federal Reserve will raise
interest rates later this month.
The Fed raised its benchmark rate by a quarter point in September
in an effort to curb stubborn inflation.
Average wages in September were up just 3% from a year ago.
That's probably not enough to offset rising prices,
so workers' paychecks won't stretch as far as they used to.
Scott Horsley, NPR News, Washington.
>> Ever since the 2024 presidential election, there has been a surge in Democratic voter turnout.
That's been especially true among black voters in the U.S. South.
As NPR's Stephen Fowler reports, voting groups expect that to continue this November.
>> A lot of the turbocharged turnout is driven by opposition to President Trump's agenda.
The U.S. Supreme Court's decision this year that made it harder to prove race is a factor
in the crafting of new partisan congressional districts has also been a motivating factor, too.
Marcus Bass with the North Carolina Black Alliance.
>> I think more and more we are finding across the state diseffective voters and the voters
that feel that the political process has not improved their quality of life.
>> Strategists say increased black turnout in the South could make a key difference
in several governor and U.S. Senate races across the region.
Stephen Fowler, NPR News, Atlanta.
On Wall Street, the Dow is now at more than 280 points.
This is NPR.
Big Tech company OpenAI says it has now notified dozens of other companies of cases
where OpenAI models got into their systems and human developers were not aware of it.
OpenAI says none of these cases are as serious as the breach
into a different AI company hugging face.
That breach happened this past summer.
Two new islands have appeared off the coast of Indonesia's Krakatau volcano.
Nainarau reports this comes after a 25-hour eruption early last month.
>> The formations sit less than a mile off opposite sides of the volcano,
almost on a straight line through the volcano's crater.
That's according to Indonesia's Geological Agency, which said that both were discovered weeks
after the eruption by mariners and volunteers who sailed through the area.
While officials cannot definitively confirm the origin or composition of the islands,
their preliminary assessment said relatively fluid magma released during the eruption surfaced
through an opening, and erupted material formed these two island-like mounds offshore.
Last month's eruption disrupted thousands of flights
as volcanic ash reached heights of 50,000 feet.
For NPR News, I'm Nainarau in Jakarta, Indonesia.
>> Weather forecasters have posted flood watches for eastern Texas this morning.
